candidate_origin: V1 displacement->divorce_hazard cites rege2007 and charles2004; the original task names no specific remarriage table

admission.reason: Neither checked anchor identifies displacement effects on entry into a subsequent union. Divorce outcomes and marital-history controls are different estimands.

rege2007.title: Plant Closure and Marital Dissolution
rege2007.method: Covariate-adjusted OLS with neighborhood fixed effects; plant-closure versus stable-plant exposure
rege2007.population: Norwegian married couples at baseline 1995; husband attached to employment; source restrictions include husband <=55, plant >=10 FTEs, marriage by 1992
rege2007.remarriage_finding: No remarriage transition coefficient found. Remarriage appears in a cited book title, not an estimated outcome.

charles2004.title: Job Displacement, Disability, and Divorce
charles2004.version: April 2002 author draft; not the 2004 published version of record
locators: PDF page 42, Appendix Table 1, first estimate/SE pair
PDF page 35, Table 3 outcome and observations
charles2004.method: Pooled probit divorce model with marital-history controls; standard errors clustered within couples
charles2004.population: US PSID nationally representative sample; unique husband-wife pairs with available marital histories; first and later marriages included
charles2004.remarriage_finding: Footnote 9 excludes same-pair re-marriages while allowing a person to appear in a different unique spouse pair; it does not estimate a union-formation hazard.

adjacent_estimates.exposure: husband baseline plant closes or downsizes by more than 90 percent
adjacent_estimates.uncertainty_kind: reported robust SE clustered within husband plant
adjacent_estimates.refusal: Different outcome: marital dissolution, not subsequent union formation

adjacent_estimates.locator: Appendix Table 1, first estimate/SE pair, Husband's Second Marriage?
adjacent_estimates.contrast: second versus omitted first marriage, conditional on model controls
adjacent_estimates.uncertainty_kind: reported robust SE clustered within couples
adjacent_estimates.refusal: Observational prior-marriage control; neither displacement treatment nor remarriage outcome

adjacent_estimates.locator: Appendix Table 1, first estimate/SE pair, Wife's Second Marriage?
adjacent_estimates.contrast: second versus omitted first marriage, conditional on model controls
adjacent_estimates.uncertainty_kind: reported robust SE clustered within couples
adjacent_estimates.refusal: Observational prior-marriage control; neither displacement treatment nor remarriage outcome

admission_contract.source_class: Draft and working-paper source copies; no precision-tier upgrade or coefficient admission
admission_contract.overlap_rule: Do not reuse divorce incidence as remarriage incidence or add a marital-history control as a new displacement pathway
admission_contract.future_requirement: Obtain a primary study of first subsequent union after dissolution, with a defined origin population, time since event, same-pair reunions versus new partners, marriage versus cohabitation, death/censoring treatment, effect scale and uncertainty

scope_limit: Screens the two V1 divorce anchors only; not a systematic review or evidence that displacement has no effect on remarriage
